'''Antibiotics''' were common medicines that were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Antibiotics were commonly found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and could be used to treat a variety of illnesses, injuries, and ailments.

==Description==
An antibiotic was a general use medicine that could be administered to patients to treat a variety of ailments, including [[Poison/Legends|poisons]], animal venom, [[Disease/Legends|diseases]], infectious microbes,<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], and germs.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Antibiotics were part of the standard medicines included in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]],<ref name="EGWT" /> while [[medpatch]]es were designed to apply antibiotics and [[coagulant]]s directly to an injury.<ref name="GFT" /> [[MD-1 medical droid]]s were programmed to work with [[Computer/Legends|computers]] to formulate and develop antibiotics as well as [[Antidote/Legends|antidotes]] and [[vaccine]]s.<ref name="SWS" />

==History==
While stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Kornell Divini]] treated a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] construction chief with antibiotics, [[Anti-virus|antivirals]], and [[antiprion]]s after the patient developed a secondary infection following a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and [[Lung/Legends|lung]] transplant.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

[[Khedryn Faal]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|Junker]]'', converted one of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] passenger berths into a medical treatment room. He stocked antibiotics in transparent storage lockers alongside gauze, scissors, [[stim-shot]]s, [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]], and other medical equipment.<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was escaping from the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brother's [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] enforcers, she loaded a steel metal tray with antibiotics, among other things.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
